create_demux_config: create a demux config to load headerless audio files with a specified format like s16le
create_decode_config: create a decode config to specify a custom decoder like libopenh264 for H264 video
create_cuda_config: create a CUDA config to specify device index and custom stream for GPU data transfer
create_video_encode_config: create a video encode config to set height, width, frame rate, and pixel format for encoding
create_audio_encode_config: create an audio encode config to set channels, sample rate, and sample format for encoding
